item.text: When the immediate test passes, no further implementation or test edit is allowed until a bounded lightweight sanity review and the repository’s fast pre-commit gate pass, a signed commit is created, and the delivery-mode-authorized push or local checkpoint completes. After push, the next iteration begins immediately while exact-SHA CI is monitored concurrently; a CI failure preempts work through the existing recovery protocol. No duplicate comprehensive local exact-commit gate is required.
